seal_closing_design: the AtlasX precondition judges a parent under the repository's Declaration (declared seal policy, pinned integrity envelope, declared principal registry, read from --root; --policy/--envelope refused), requires the verification and integrity reports to be internally consistent (summaries, counts and verdicts re-derived from outcomes and evaluations; the integrity report against the pin), and as its last check re-runs seal::gate (authority first; the container at its recomputed pre-seal root) and admits only when the gate decides ELIGIBLE and exactly the record the container carries. The seal is not signed: Atlas holds no key (ADR 0085). AdmittedParent names policy_id, principal, principal_key and registry_digest.
